mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where GDP y/y growth accelerates by > 1pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a tight labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE drops below 4%.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth slows by more than 2% y/y, it signals a supply-driven slowdown that will weigh on S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where INDPRO y/y growth is below 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts growth accelerates by more than 10% y/y, it signals a demand boom that will boost S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of instances where HOUST y/y growth exceeds 10%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 4%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4%.

mechanism_narrative: When real consumer spending growth slows by more than 2% y/y, it signals a demand-driven slowdown that will weigh on S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 40% of instances where RSAFS y/y growth is below -2%.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment growth slows by more than 100k jobs per month y/y, it signals a labor market slowdown that will weigh on S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where PAYEMS y/y growth is below -100k jobs per month.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate rises above 3% y/y, it signals an inflationary environment that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL y/y exceeds 3%.
